records.title: MetaAttention: A Unified and Performant Attention Framework across Hardware Backends
records.reason: The author institutional repository abstract describes a hardware-specific attention runtime and kernel search.

records.title: When to Think Fast and Slow? AMOR: Adaptive Entropy Gate for Hybrid Models
records.reason: AMOR dynamically gates attention computation based on uncertainty to improve efficiency.

records.title: RepetitionCurse: Measuring and Understanding Router Imbalance in Mixture-of-Experts LLMs under DoS Stress
records.reason: The paper measures routing concentration, device imbalance, TTFT, and inference latency in MoE serving.

records.title: KV Admission: Learning What to Write for Efficient Long-Context LLM Inference
records.reason: KV Admission reduces cache writes, memory use, and prefill/decode cost for long-context inference.

records.title: Error-Free Linear Attention is a Free Lunch: Exact Solution from Continuous-Time Dynamics
records.reason: The arXiv primary record describes linear-time attention with chunkwise parallelism; DOI resolves to arXiv.

records.title: HetRL: Efficient Reinforcement Learning for LLMs in Heterogeneous Environments
records.reason: HetRL targets distributed reinforcement-learning post-training scheduling, not inference or serving.

records.title: Autoregressive Image Generation Needs Only a Few Lines of Cached Tokens
records.reason: LineAR compresses autoregressive visual-generation KV cache and reports memory and throughput gains.

records.title: Rethinking LoRA Memory Through the Lens of KV Cache Compression
records.reason: The work analyzes document adapters with KV-cache compression at decoding time, related to inference memory.

records.title: AURA: Action-Gated Memory for Robot Policies at Constant VRAM
records.reason: AURA compares recurrent memory with KV cache under long-running edge VLA inference and reports fixed memory/write trade-offs.

records.title: QVGGT: Post-Training Quantized Visual Geometry Grounded Transformer
records.reason: QVGGT quantizes a visual-geometry model for AR/UAV deployment, not LLM inference or an LLM system.

records.title: Bastion: Budget-Aware Speculative Decoding with Tree-structured Block Diffusion Drafting
records.reason: BASTION is hardware-aware speculative decoding and reports decoding speedups.

records.title: Laguna M.1/XS.2 Technical Report
records.reason: The report spans training and inference, but its abstract does not identify a specific inference/serving systems contribution.

records.title: Selective Latent Thinking: Adaptive Compression of LLM Reasoning Chains
records.reason: SLT selectively compresses reasoning spans to reduce autoregressive inference cost.

records.title: CONF-KV: Confidence-Aware KV Cache Eviction with Mixed-Precision Storage for Long-Horizon LLM
records.reason: CONF-KV adapts KV-cache budget and precision to reduce memory while preserving long-context retrieval.

records.title: Tensor Cache: Eviction-conditioned Associative Memory for Transformers
records.reason: Tensor Cache adds bounded secondary associative memory for evicted KV pairs and studies long-context memory/quality.

records.title: AB-Sparse: Sparse Attention with Adaptive Block Size for Accurate and Efficient Long-Context Inference
records.reason: AB-Sparse co-designs adaptive sparse attention, KV quantization, and GPU kernels for long-context inference.

records.title: Unleashing Scalable Context Parallelism for Foundation Models Pre-Training via FCP
records.reason: FCP addresses context parallelism and throughput for foundation-model pretraining, outside this inference/serving screen.

records.title: OSAQ: Outlier Self-Absorption for Accurate Low-bit LLM Quantization
records.reason: OSAQ is a low-bit LLM weight-quantization method that reduces inference memory without runtime overhead.

records.title: QKVShare: Quantized KV-Cache Handoff for Multi-Agent On-Device LLMs
records.reason: QKVShare quantizes KV handoff between on-device LLM agents and reports TTFT reductions against re-prefill.

records.title: Agentic AI Systems Should Be Designed as Marginal Token Allocators
records.reason: The position paper connects serving with latency/cost allocation but presents no concrete inference-system method or evaluated system.
